subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should the web composer ship hold-to-record dictation enabled by default, with the existing Talk mic action retained only for quick taps?
rationale: The branch adds a new default interaction and a persisted user preference, so correctness evidence alone cannot determine the intended product and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Sponsor default-on dictation
options.body: Accept the interaction direction after real browser proof demonstrates that quick tap, long hold, cancellation, and transcript insertion behave as intended.

options.title: Ship opt-in first
options.body: Keep the implementation but make hold-to-record disabled until users explicitly enable it in Settings.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the branch until a maintainer defines the composer microphone interaction policy and expected rollout path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-on dictation
recommendation.body: Accept the interaction direction after real browser proof demonstrates that quick tap, long hold, cancellation, and transcript insertion behave as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context ties this author to the complete implementation and interaction proposal; current-main area ownership was not available in the review context.
